'''Jwartek''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], Jwartek was inducted into the ranks of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Over time, Jwartek was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and eventually attained the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. As a Knight, Jwartek studied as a [[Jedi Consular]], pursuing the rare specialization of the [[Jedi artisan/Legends|Jedi artisan]]. As part of his studies, Jwartek improved his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], enhancing the original hilt with a fallen branch from an ancient tree.<ref name="JAPC" />
